title: Semi-automated detection of droplet collision-coalescence using digital in-line holography: code, models and numerical data
description: Numerical materials and trained collision models for Semi-automated detection of droplet collision-coalescence using digital in-line holography. Supports all three pretrained models on the complete independent test seed 260745, Tables 3–4, and Figures 4, 5, 7, 8 and 11–15. Includes 3D test trajectories, compact candidate and image measurements, numerical figure inputs and the 1,120-row top-80 experimental review cohort. Preparation calculates trajectory features and test particle states locally and verifies reference checksums. Five-seed training data, supplementary evaluations, full experimental sequence replay, raw images and upstream particle-measurement weights are outside this reduced distribution.
